meta.title: Read the Project Details tab of a live project
gaps: The Events list navigation, title search, and row selection cannot be performed because the prepared-state rules require opening the existing event directly with open_prepared.
The exact Project ID and Created at values cannot be compared because no catalog assertion exposes those dynamic values.
The exact Participants 0/N ratio cannot be asserted because the prepared event's invited-vendor total is not exposed as an API value or fixed case value.
The exact quotation-sheet names, per-sheet Download association, and clause contents cannot be asserted; only their visible labels can be checked.
The open-in-new-tab icon beside Stage Title cannot be asserted as a distinct control.

steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ on its Project Details summary screen as required for the prepared state.
Verify that the Project Details view is visible.
Check that the project metadata includes the Project ID field.
Check that the project metadata includes the creation timestamp field.
Check the case's expected Published Stages column label for the RFQ stage code.
Check that an RFQ stage-code value is displayed with the expected RFQ prefix.
Verify the Published Stages table exposes the stage title column.
Verify the Published Stages table exposes pending actions.
Verify participant information is shown for the published stage.
Verify the stage start-time field is shown.
Verify the stage end-time field is shown.
Confirm that the Published Stages table rendered at least one stage row.
Verify the quotation-template section is present.
Verify that a template download control is available.
Verify the terms-and-conditions section is present.
Ensure the Project Details screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or undefined values.
